draft.title: Ethical business decisions
card: An ethical business treats its workers, customers and the environment fairly. For example, it deals with customers honestly, with true prices and claims.
Corporate social responsibility (CSR) means a business acts for the good of workers, communities and the environment, not only for profit. It goes beyond what the law requires.
Obeying the law is the minimum. A business that only does what the law demands is not showing CSR.
CSR examples include cutting waste, buying from sustainable sources, paying for staff training, and supporting a local community. It is a choice and can cost money.
draft.remember: Ethical businesses act fairly, and CSR goes past legal duties to help people and the planet.

a.q: A bakery owner wants the business to show corporate social responsibility. Which action fits best?
opts: It donates unsold bread to a local shelter
It pays its staff the award wage the law sets
It follows food safety rules so it can open
It lowers its prices to attract more customers
a.why: Donating unsold bread helps the community, and no law requires it. Paying the award wage is tempting, but the law requires it, so it is only the minimum. Lowering prices to attract customers is aimed at profit.
a.clue: Ask who gains, and whether the law requires it.

b.q: Tariq owns a furniture company in Newcastle. Which decision shows CSR instead of only meeting his legal duties?
opts: He buys timber only from sustainably managed forests
He fits the safety equipment that workplace laws require
He pays company tax on the profit the business earns
He lowers prices to win customers from a rival store
b.why: Buying only sustainable timber protects the environment and goes beyond what the law demands. Fitting required safety equipment is tempting because it helps workers, but it is a legal duty, so it does not go beyond the law.
b.clue: Ask whether the law would have made him do it.

a.best: It donates unsold bread to a local shelter

b.best: He buys timber only from sustainably managed forests
